suitability.rationale: Directly addresses purified-target biochemical inhibition and appropriately limits cellular inference.
response_quotes: purified recombinant human MAP3K7/TAK1 (O43318) kinase in vitro; no cell system used

procedural_soundness.rationale: Coherent preparation, reaction, ATP depletion, detection and analysis with intended controls, but substrate, concentrations, timing and detection settings remain unresolved. The compound-only blank lacks a defined positive ADP signal for assessing quenching. This remains an outline.
response_quotes: Stop the reaction with ADP-Glo reagent to deplete residual ATP, then add kinase detection reagent and read luminescence.
compound-only blank at top concentration to detect luminescence quenching/interference by CHEMBL1077979

numerical_soundness.rationale: Internally consistent and explicitly provisional series, but broad-window language insufficiently justifies the specific endpoints contextually. Triplicates lack a precision justification and distinction between technical and independent repeats. No arithmetic contradiction or fabricated numerical source is evident.
response_quotes: A 30 uM top concentration with 3-fold dilution over 10 points and triplicates is a design assumption intended to span a wide potency window

not_assessable_components: Comparability of retained assays to proposed ADP-Glo conditions.
Compatibility of unspecified enzyme preparation, substrate and buffer with ADP-Glo.
Optimal temperature, preincubation time, vehicle tolerance and compound solubility.
assumption_handling: Clearly separates proposed numerical settings from evidence and leaves essential conditions unresolved. The preincubation example supports an analogy, not transfer of duration or validation of ADP-Glo. Lab convention and an unavailable manufacturer protocol do not resolve the operating gaps.

numeric_check.notes: Nine dilution intervals give minimum 0.0015241579 uM (1.5241579 nM); no conflicting endpoint is stated. Vehicle fraction 0.01 equals 1%.

review_reason: Assay compatibility, operating conditions, interference controls and range feasibility require domain review and pilot validation.
